theme_variables.subject: Library
theme_variables.required_features: Preserve the main entrance and roof structure

constraints: Preserve core rules; obey negative rules; apply conditional rules only when conditions match; resolve conflicts before generation.

rules.instruction: Render using only black and white
Use flat 2D line art, without volumetric rendering
Use simplified contours that retain essential identifying structure
Maintain clear hierarchy and moderate negative space
rules.allowed_variation: Placement may adapt to theme and aspect ratio

rules.instruction: Keep overall density restrained and remove non-identifying details
rules.allowed_variation: Local density can adapt to subject complexity

rules.instruction: Use mostly thin lines, with selectively heavier contours or accents
rules.allowed_variation: Scale widths with canvas while preserving relative hierarchy

rules.instruction: Simplify according to object structure while preserving essential identifying features
Preserve identifying roof, opening and structural relationships using simplified lines
Exclude realistic shadows and gradient lighting
Exclude unrelated grain textures and 3D gloss
